text:
nina: follow-up on the observability pipeline split RFC - small operational thing: who owns the envelope header transformation?
jorge: infra ops owns the edge transform, ingest team owns downstream envelope semantics. we need a short contract doc.
lisa: can we decide the canonical key names for billing keys? right now everyone uses different names.
ben: proposal: billing.project, billing.team, billing.account_id. keep snake case dotted.
nina: +1. add billing.project_id to be explicit.
jorge: question: when we do envelope-level dedup, should we dedup before or after header copy?
lisa: after header copy otherwise we risk losing billing attribution for deduped events.
ben: also need a tiny schema for the stub span emitted when payload dropped. minimal fields: trace_id, span_id_stub, service, drop_reason, preserved_billing_keys.
nina: example stub: {trace_id: "...", span_id_stub: "...", service: "mobile-sync", drop_reason: "low_value"} - but per agents spec, keep messages short.
ops-bot: canary status: transform-service v3.2 deployed to canary namespace.
jorge: next: write the envelope header contract and post to rfc thread, also add a migration checklist for SDK teams.
lisa: I'll draft the canonical key list and a tiny JSON schema.
ben: I'll add the stub-span shape to the observability schema doc.
nina: aim to land contract in 72 hours.
